Laura / Mike —

Thanks again for the productive demo yesterday. Small ask as we move toward procurement: would either of you be open to a 20–30 minute peer call with one of our existing customers who runs latency-sensitive inference for grid optimization? We typically use a couple of standard points: 1) steady-state p99 token latency at target throughput; 2) how KV cache/batching affected unit cost; 3) what an on-prem private control-plane integration looked like.

Two quick scheduling options: Tue 5/26 9am PT or Wed 5/27 11am PT. If those don't work, tell me a couple windows and we'll match.
